title: Overload fault (F02)
fullDescription:
APC Smart-UPS F02 indicates output overload. Exceeds rated VA/W and UPS may shut down to protect itself.

Disconnect some equipment, verify load within rating, and restart.

fixSteps.title: Calculate load
fixSteps.instruction: Sum watts and verify under UPS rating.

fixSteps.title: Never plug laser printers into UPS
Restart UPS
fixSteps.instruction: Press power button to clear fault.

whenToCallPro: If load is well under rating and F02 persists, service needed.

title: Battery not connected (F03)
shortDescription: UPS does not detect battery connection.
fullDescription: F03 means battery cable unplugged, blown fuse, or battery end-of-life. Without battery, no surge/runtime protection.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Install new APC RBC replacement battery.

videoSearchQuery: APC UPS F03 battery not connected fix

title: Battery disconnect error (F04)
fullDescription:
Some APC models detect battery state via comm line; F04 signals fault.

Reseat battery; replace if old.
whenToCallPro: If fault persists after battery swap.
videoSearchQuery: APC UPS F04 battery disconnect fix

title: Internal fault (F10)
fullDescription: F10 is a generic internal fault. Could be inverter, charger, or control board failure. Professional service required.

fixSteps.title: Restart
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle UPS to see if fault clears.

videoSearchQuery: APC UPS F10 internal fault fix

faq.a: APC has 2-3 year warranty on most models.

title: Parallel configuration mismatch
shortDescription: Paralleled UPS units have mismatched firmware or settings.
fullDescription: Large SRT units support parallel operation; mismatched firmware/config breaks load sharing.

fixSteps.title: Match firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Update all units to same version.

whenToCallPro: Enterprise installs benefit from APC service.
videoSearchQuery: APC SRT parallel configuration error fix

title: On battery alarm
shortDescription: UPS is running on battery due to input power loss or fault.
fullDescription: Normal response to power outage or out-of-spec input. Beeps every 30s. Save work and shut down if extended.

fixSteps.title: Save work
fixSteps.instruction: Shut down gracefully if outage long.

fixSteps.title: Check sensitivity
fixSteps.instruction: If frequent, reduce sensitivity in PowerChute.

videoSearchQuery: APC UPS on battery alarm explained

title: Replace battery alarm
fullDescription:
After ~3-5 years, sealed lead-acid batteries lose capacity. UPS flags need for replacement.

Replace with APC RBC equivalent or quality third-party pack.

fixSteps.title: Order RBC
fixSteps.instruction: Find correct RBC number for your UPS.

fixSteps.title: Hot-swap battery
fixSteps.instruction: Many Smart-UPS support hot battery replacement.

whenToCallPro: Large SRT with heavy battery packs.
videoSearchQuery: APC UPS replace battery fix RBC

faq.a: Work, but quality varies; RBC genuine recommended.

title: Output off
fullDescription: Output may be off due to overload shutdown, remote command, or manual press. Press power button to restore.
videoSearchQuery: APC UPS output off turn on

faq.a: Yes when plugged in, even output off.

title: Fan replacement needed
fullDescription: SRT and larger Smart-UPS have fans for inverter cooling. Failure risks overheating shutdown.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: APC service for in-warranty; DIY advanced otherwise.

faq.a: Only briefly; shutdown to avoid damage.

title: Temperature warning
fullDescription: High ambient temperatures or airflow blockage cause overheat. Reduce load or improve ventilation.

fixSteps.title: Check airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Clear space around UPS, cool room.

title: EPO activated
shortDescription: Emergency Power Off button or circuit triggered.
fullDescription: Enterprise UPS have EPO connector allowing remote kill switch. If triggered, output disabled and must be reset manually.

fixSteps.title: Verify EPO circuit
fixSteps.instruction: Check that EPO switch/loop is in normal state.

fixSteps.title: Reset UPS
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle UPS with EPO cleared.

whenToCallPro: EPO wiring is life-safety; have electrician verify.

title: Site wiring fault
shortDescription: Missing ground or reversed polarity on outlet.
fullDescription:
UPS detects wiring problem in building outlet. Common issues: open ground, reversed hot/neutral.

Engage electrician — ground faults are safety risk.
videoSearchQuery: APC UPS site wiring fault fix

faq.a: No — surge protection won't work without ground.
